Title: Validate on the server, encode on output
Body: Client-side checks are for convenience only. Validate every input on the server, and encode output for the context (HTML, URL, SQL) it lands in.

Title: Use parameterised queries, always
Body: Never build SQL by joining strings. Parameters keep data from ever being read as commands, in every language and ORM.

Title: Patch on a schedule
Body: Update dependencies weekly with automation and tests. Most breaches use vulnerabilities that already had fixes.

Title: Log security events, not secrets
Body: Record logins, failures, permission changes and resets with who and when, so incidents can be investigated. Never log passwords, tokens or full card numbers.

Title: Practise your response
Body: Decide who does what when something goes wrong, and rehearse restoring from backup and rotating keys before you need to.
